scope: README.rst226-605 now read; combined with v32 covers1-605 only, not full1286-line document. External references not opened or endorsed.

findings.detail: README explicitly limits application to archival/static data and says insertion/deletion/missing-file recovery is generally unsupported. Retain these boundaries rather than assuming universal repair from ECC branding.

README strongly requires identical generation/correction parameters and independent preservation. This corroborates source behavior: comments are not automatically authoritative decoding configuration.

README says successful repair is checked before committing blocks. Source OR acceptance and probable-repair messaging do not constitute independent original-byte verification; previously reproduced parser coverage gaps further limit the claim.

Claim that rfigc identifies corruption without ambiguity is contradicted by reproduced headerless-database false success and unchecked complete-corpus scope. Claim requires narrower conditions than prose states.

README promises header protection ensures files can always be opened. No format-specific decoder verification follows source repair; header bytes alone do not prove format validity or whole-file equality.
Storage-medium/RAID/PAR2 comparisons are upstream prose, not independently verified research or recommendations in this audit. Do not transfer external hardware claims into library requirements.
